name: How do rent-ready tiny homes compare to traditional ADUs in terms of build time and cost?
description: Rent-ready tiny homes offer faster build times and often lower costs compared to traditional site-built ADUs, providing a quicker path to rental income.

mainEntity.name: How do rent-ready tiny homes compare to traditional ADUs in terms of build time and cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rent-ready tiny homes from Zen Tiny Homes offer a streamlined alternative to traditional site-built ADUs. They are typically constructed off-site in a controlled environment, which often results in shorter build times (8-12 weeks vs. 6-12+ months) and reduced labor costs. While a traditional ADU might offer more architectural flexibility, our tiny homes provide a faster, more predictable path to generating rental income, often at a lower overall price point, without compromising quality or compliance.
